newsitem.title: ROMANIA: French child-sex suspect held in Romania.
newsitem.headline: French child-sex suspect held in Romania.

text.p: A French citizen was arrested on paedophilia charges on Friday after a private Romanian television station broadcast film it said showed a French-speaking tourist in bed with two under-age boys.
A police spokesman said the suspect was picked up on Thursday at a flat near Bucharest's main railway station.
He was initially released but arrested again after police received further evidence.
Pornography and child prostitution have become rampant in Romania since the 1989 anti-communist revolt ended strict social controls.
Hundreds of children from poor backgrounds leave their homes to live in squalor on Bucharest streets and are easy prey for paedophiles from Western countries.
